content:
incident-bot: Pager alert — HIGH: GPU pool eu-west-1-gpu exhausted (capacity=50). Autoscaler failed to provision additional capacity. Queue length: 12,340. 90th pct token latency > 6s. Provider returned 429 on instance create. See: https://internal.redwood/ops/incident/4378901234

oncall-ryan: ack. I'm on it. pulling up logs and autoscaler status.

sre-maya: joining. what’s the root cause the bot showed? provider 429 suggests rate limit or regional quota.

infra-jo: confirmed — provider API returning 429 rate_limited on POST /instances. We hit provider per-min provisioning QPS. Autoscaler tried to add +8 but got throttled, backoff kicked in. Current pool usage: 45/50 active, queue backlog growing.

ml-eli: customer impact: at least three hosted tenants reporting errors (503s) and one big customer seeing slow streaming. Telemetry: failed requests spike at 02:13 UTC.

product-lina: pinged support to start customer comms. Which prod endpoints are most impacted? embeddings? realtime chat?

ml-eli: generation endpoints (chat + text-gen) primarily. Embeddings less impacted.

oncall-ryan: quick mitigation idea: (A) route low-priority traffic to eu-east-1 warm pool; (B) temporarily enable per-customer throttles for heavy tenants; (C) reduce per-request token budget for batchers to free capacity. Can infra do cross-region routing?

infra-jo: yes, we can create a routing rule in TrafficRouter to send a percentage of traffic to eu-east-1 warm nodes. Risk: increased latency for those requests. I can flip a 25% diversion now.

engops-bot: autoscale-md: current state: scale_attempts=3, last_error=429_rate_limit, backoff=exponential, next_retry=30s.

oncall-ryan: do it. 25% diversion. Also apply per-customer rate limit for top 5 callers.

infra-jo: flipping diversion -> 25%. patch:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/traffic-router/rules \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOK" \ 
  -d '{"match":"eu-west-1","percent":25,"target":"eu-east-1"}'
```

infra-jo: done. routing change pushed, caches invalidated. Observability: passing new traffic to eu-east.

oncall-ryan: applying per-customer soft throttle for top 5 heavy tenants. Will set to 60% of baseline.

engops-bot: throttle update: success for tenants [acct-112, acct-440, acct-998].

sre-maya: checking queue: backlog dropped from 12,340 -> 6,900 in 3m after diversion. Good signal. Are we still seeing provider 429s?

infra-jo: provider 429s decreased but still intermittently returning for provisioning requests. Autoscaler still backing off.

ml-eli: customer reports: partial recovery for streaming but some requests still get queued. Support is updating customers: "mitigation in progress, restoring capacity".

product-lina: good — keep me posted so we can coordinate a brief status across accounts.

oncall-ryan: next steps: (1) escalate to IC to coordinate longer-term fix (2) consider manual provisioning via provider console if safe (3) gather quota increase request to provider.

carol-ic: taking command. thanks @oncall-ryan. status check: diversion and throttles are stabilizing queue. Can infra attempt manual provisioning of 5 instances in eu-west-1 to relieve immediate pressure? We'll monitor failure rate.

infra-jo: I can attempt manual provisioning for 5 nodes but provider console shows "rate limit" as well. Manual attempts might succeed intermittently. Will try now for staggered provisioning (1 every 15s) to avoid busting their QPS.

infra-jo: manual provisioning attempt 1/5: succeeded. 2/5: 429. backoff. 3/5: succeeded. current active: 47/50.

sre-maya: good. still not full recovery. queue at 4,100 and trending down. Latency percentiles improving.

carol-ic: mitigation summary: diversion 25% to eu-east-1, per-customer throttles applied, manual provisioning partial success. Begin mitigation->stabilize. Assign action items for postmortem.

oncall-ryan: handing off active pager to carol-ic at 02:30 UTC for incident lead. I'm going offline for a quick break.

carol-ic: acknowledged handoff. I'll keep the bridge open for 30m and coordinate with provider to get quota cleared.

infra-jo: opening provider support ticket (ref: INC-9281) requesting temporary expansion of provisioning QPS for eu-west. ETA from provider unknown.

engops-bot: provider-ticket: INC-9281 created. initial response timeframe: 45-90m.

carol-ic: notes for postmortem draft (capture now while fresh):
- timeline of events (first alert, autoscaler attempts, provider 429s)
- immediate mitigations executed (traffic diversion, per-customer throttles, manual provisioning)
- customer impact summary (list of affected tenants, error rates, duration)
- root causes to explore (provider rate limits, autoscaler retry/backoff strategy, pool maxScale vs observed demand)
- action items and owners (quota request automation, autoscaler retry policy update, cross-region fallback playbook)

sre-maya: adding one more: validate warm-pool sizes and heat-up times for eu-east to ensure diversion is effective next time.

ml-eli: add: add a traffic-classification rule to route non-streaming/async workloads to cheaper cold capacity during surges.

carol-ic: action items (assigned):
- INFRA-2001: Automate provider quota escalation flow and alert when provider QPS nearing limit -> owner: infra-jo
- SRE-2102: Update autoscaler backoff to use jittered linear retry when provider 429s detected -> owner: sre-maya
- DEVEX-314: Document and test cross-region diversion playbook in runbooks -> owner: oncall-ryan (post-incident)
- ML-402: Evaluate warm-pool sizing and heat-up -> owner: ml-eli
- PROD-88: Customer comms template for capacity incidents -> owner: product-lina

product-lina: I'll draft a short customer note and coordinate with support.

carol-ic: closing notes: incident classified as Sev2 (regional impact, mitigated). Postmortem owner: carol-ic. Target postmortem published within 72h. If anyone has logs/screenshots, drop them in the incident doc.

engops-bot: incident state -> mitigated. closed pager at 02:47 UTC.

carol-ic: thanks everyone. follow-ups via the action items above. I'll open a postmortem doc and assign tasks in JIRA.

oncall-ryan: back — great work team.

sre-maya: extra note: let's add a monitoring alert for provisioning 429 rate to avoid noisy weeks-long detection lag.

infra-jo: will add alert rule.

carol-ic: thread end — transitioning to post-incident review channel in ~1h.
